alalal-e84446-d1e104.summary: Rubric of Article 20: whether faith is the foundation.

alalal-e84446-d1e111.summary: Introduces the question on Lombard's statement that faith is the foundation of goods, which no one can change.

alalal-e84446-d1e123.summary: First objection: fortitude seems to be the foundation, since the Gloss on Luke 12:4 says fortitude is the foundation of faith.

alalal-e84446-d1e146.summary: Second objection: humility seems to be the foundation, since Bernard calls it the precious ground on which other virtues are founded.

alalal-e84446-d1e160.summary: Third objection: fear seems to be the foundation, since Ecclesiasticus 25 says the fear of God is above all and is the beginning of his love.

alalal-e84446-d1e177.summary: Fourth objection: Augustine says fear introduces charity as the bristle the thread, so fear first founds the building.

alalal-e84446-d1e191.summary: Solution: faith is simply prior and founding; the others found only in a qualified sense. Humility comes after faith but hollows the heart so that what faith founds is set deeper, digging the trench for the foundation. Fortitude founds as a buttress against storms of temptation and persecution.
claims: Faith alone is the foundation simply; humility and fortitude found only in a qualified sense.

alalal-e84446-d1e217.summary: Continues: fear founds by excluding what would overturn the building's structure, by turning away from sin; faith alone founds by underlying substantially as first in the building.
claims: Fear protects the building by turning from sin, but only faith underlies it substantially.

alalal-e84446.summary: Article 20 asks whether faith is the foundation of the spiritual life, given that authorities call fortitude, humility and fear foundations. Albert holds that faith alone is the foundation simply, underlying the whole building as first. The others found only in a qualified sense. Humility, which follows faith, digs the trench so that the foundation is set deeper. Fortitude buttresses it against temptation and persecution. Fear protects it by turning away from sin.
claims: Faith alone is the foundation of the spiritual life simply.
Humility, fortitude and fear are foundations only in qualified senses: preparing, buttressing and protecting the building.
